vocab.exampleEn: There is often a trade-off between speed and accuracy.
vocab.exampleZh: 速度和准确性之间经常需要取舍。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use trade-off when both sides have advantages and disadvantages.
vocab.upgradeZh: 当两边都有利弊时，可以用 trade-off。

cycle.summaryEn: Learn how to describe trends, compare data, and write a proper overview.
cycle.summaryZh: 学会描述趋势、比较数据，并写出像样的总览。

frame.useEn: Use to show your opinion clearly.

meaningEn: This writing word helps Becky build stronger IELTS paragraphs and ideas.
meaningZh: 这个写作词可以帮助 Becky 写出更强的雅思段落和观点。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "trade-off" using In my view, ...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "trade-off" 和 在我看来，... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
